sql: SELECT ProductCategoryName, ProductSubcategoryName, SalesAmount FROM (SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName AS ProductCategoryName, ps.ProductSubcategoryName AS ProductSubcategoryName, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.ProductCategoryKey ORDER BY sum(f.SalesAmount) DESC) AS rn FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009 GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryKey, pc.ProductCategoryName, ps.ProductSubcategoryName) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY SalesAmount DESC
